steps: Plug in AC power or lower the loop rate: magic run --interval 600
Check battery health: upower -i $(upower -e | grep BAT)
Check fans and airflow; clean vents
Pause heavy jobs until zone temp < 80C (see heatgate / tick-sandbox throttling)
Inspect top consumers: ps -eo pid,pcpu,comm --sort=-pcpu | head
Lower the loop rate or run under tick-sandbox with fewer workers
Inspect memory: free -h; ps -eo pid,rss,comm --sort=-rss | head
Stop or restart the largest non-essential process
Run your backup job for the stale path
Verify the backup restores a sample file
Check link: ip addr; ip route
Restart network manager only with owner approval
Inspect resolver: resolvectl status (or cat /etc/resolv.conf)
Try an alternate resolver only with owner approval
Check: timedatectl status
Enable sync with owner approval: sudo timedatectl set-ntp true
List the oldest archives in the archive dir
Move them to cold storage after owner approval (nothing is deleted automatically)
Review: apt list --upgradable
Apply with owner approval: sudo apt upgrade
Pin each unpinned requirement to the tested version (name==x.y.z)
Re-run tests and open a PR for review
Fork the repo to a throwaway fork (do not touch upstream)
Create a disposable branch on the fork, e.g. fix/ci-light-<run-id>
Reproduce the dark run from its log; make the smallest fix on the fork branch
Prove the fork's CI turns lit
Only with the owner's OK: open an upstream PR from the fork branch
Never force-push, never delete or rename branches or tags
Review security updates: apt list --upgradable | grep -i security
Apply with owner approval, then reboot if /var/run/reboot-required exists
Tighten permissions with owner approval: chmod 600 <path>
Contents were never read; verify owner is correct: stat <path>
